text:
Maya: Heading into PRD review for Dedicated Capacity — need to lock SLA targets, sizing assumptions, autoscale rules. Drop blockers.
Dave: Quick Q — are we keeping 99.95% availability + p99 latency SLOs per reserved pool, or sliding by model class? :thinking_face:
Priya: For tier-1 customers we promised p99 < 300ms gen latency for ~2k tokens on 8xA100-equivalent. Need to confirm measurement path (ingress->runtime->egress) and whether warm cache is assumed.
Sam: Can we add clear acceptance criteria: synthetic perf runs + one customer beta (2 weeks) with their traffic profile; plus rollback policy for regressions.
Maya: Draft acceptance criteria idea: 1) e2e p99 < 300ms for 95% of synthetic runs; 2) measured throughput meets sizing (see Dave calc); 3) autoscale responds such that GPU util <= 80% under steady-state; 4) graceful fallback to compatible smaller model variant on capacity shortage.
Dave: Sizing sketch: throughput per 8xA100 ~150 req/s for model-m under target tokens. So 10k qps -> ~67 GPUs (with 1.2x headroom). I'll push a spreadsheet.
Priya: Cold-scale concerns: node boot + container cold-starts. Add pre-warm policy: keep 10% headroom available for spikes >5% sustained for 60s.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: capacity-test harness starting in staging in 30m.
Sam: Edge cases to add to PRD: KV cache miss storms, long-context (10k tokens) requests, model OOMs. Define automatic fallback to reduce context length or route to paid high-memory pool.
Maya: SLA wording for PRD proposal: "Redwood Dedicated — Latency SLO (p99) 300ms for model classes A/B for standard context (<=2k tokens); Availability 99.95% per monthly billing period excluding scheduled maintenance."
Dave: Recommend adding a performance-degradation-credit clause for large-context workloads and private/on-prem deployments where infra is customer-managed.
Priya: Acceptance test checklist (concise): - run loadgen mix (70% short gen, 20% mid, 10% long); - verify autoscale timeline & event logs; - KV cache hit-rate >=60% after warmup; - billing & customer tags present in metrics.
Maya: Autoscale config example to paste into PRD (placeholder):
```json
{"policy":"target_utilization","target_gpu_util":0.8,"cooldown_s":30,"max_replicas":200}
```
Dave: I'll add tweaks: scale-down cooldown_s=60, healthcheck fail threshold=5 -> drain. Also ensure scale-up is conservative to avoid oscillation.
Sam: Timeline: PRD freeze EOD Friday, full staging perf runs next week, beta with two customers in ~3 weeks.
Priya: I'll own the acceptance criteria section and link the perf harness repo.
Maya: Great. Please add a short section in PRD for monitoring/alerting paths (traces, token-level cost, rollback playbook). Ping me for final sign-off. :eyes:
